test_coverage_notes: Test coverage is likely present in integration/system tests that start the node with various command line arguments and config files (e.g., tests for node identity, config parsing, and error handling). Unit tests may exist for parseGenericSeed and parseBase58<Seed> in their respective modules. However, direct unit tests for getNodeIdentity's error handling (invalid nodeid, invalid config seed, fallback to DB) may be missing or only covered indirectly. Edge cases (e.g., both nodeid and config missing, malformed seeds) should be explicitly tested. Look for test files in test/app/main/ or test/core/ for coverage; gaps may exist if only happy paths are tested.
